title: The Robotic Surgery Leader: Intuitive Surgical Slides Further But One Wall Street Bull Pegs Returns at 85%
excerpt: Intuitive Surgical has shed a third of its value while its robotic surgery peers barely flinched, and Wall Street's most bullish analyst sees an outcome that...
content_html:
Quick Read

  • ISRG dropped 34% on a slower procedure growth guide, yet Q2 EPS of $2.80 crushed the $2.50 consensus for a fifth straight quarterly beat.

  • ISRG trades 28% below Wall Street consensus while peers MDT and SYK fell less than 10% YTD, suggesting the market overcorrected on the category leader.

  • Bernstein's $685 target implies 83% upside with the bull case hinging on the da Vinci 5 upgrade cycle mirroring the prior seven-year Xi ramp.

  • Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Intuitive Surgical didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

Intuitive Surgical (NASDAQ:ISRG) trades at $373.71, while the average Wall Street price target sits at $477.25. That leaves the stock roughly 28% below consensus, and Bernstein pegs fair value at $685, implying returns north of 83%.

Intuitive Surgical dominates the robotic-assisted surgery market with its da Vinci surgical system and Ion lung biopsy platform. It has an installed base of 11,710 da Vinci systems worldwide. Wall Street has treated it as a compounder for years, making the current gap between price and target notable.

How A Compounder Lost A Third Of Its Value

ISRG is down 34.02% year to date and 21.17% over the past twelve months. The trigger was a slower guide, not a broken business. Full-year 2026 da Vinci procedure growth was set at 13.5% to 15.5%, a clear deceleration from the roughly 18% pace investors expected.

Tariffs compounded the damage. Instruments and accessories are manufactured in Mexico, endoscopes in Germany, and certain materials come from China. Management embedded a 1.0% revenue drag from tariffs into gross margin guidance and warned further escalation could materially hit results. HSBC downgraded the stock from Buy to Hold and cut its target from $604 to $391. A Class II recall of 11,113 da Vinci SP drapes added noise, and moderation in U.S. elective procedures tied to ACA subsidy expiration finished the decline.

Act now: the analyst who called NVIDIA in 2010 just named his top 10 AI stocks — and Intuitive Surgical didn't make the cut. Grab the names FREE today.

Why The Bulls Are Still On Board

Analysts remain bullish because the underlying business kept beating expectations through the selloff. Q2 2026 non-GAAP EPS came in at $2.80 versus a $2.50 consensus, revenue of $2.89 billion grew 18.5% year over year, marking the fifth consecutive quarterly beat. Non-GAAP gross margin expanded to 70.0% from 67.9%.

The bull thesis rests on the da Vinci 5 upgrade cycle. Placements hit 246 dV5 systems in Q2, and CFO Jamie Samath compared the trajectory to the Xi cycle, which "took about seven years before we got to the peak trade-in volumes.". Add a growing recurring instruments base, $8.63 billion in cash, and an extended-use instrument program rolling out in 2027. The rating mix shows 7 analysts rate ISRG Strong Buy, 16 Buy, 9 Hold, and just 1 Sell.

Intuitive Surgical（纳斯达克股票代码：ISRG）的交易价格为 373.71 美元，而华尔街的平均目标价格为 477.25 美元。 这使得该股比共识低约 28%，伯恩斯坦将公允价值定为 685 美元，这意味着回报率超过 83%。

Intuitive Surgical 凭借其达芬奇手术系统和离子肺活检平台在机器人辅助手术市场占据主导地位。 它在全球安装了 11,710 套达芬奇系统。 多年来，华尔街一直将其视为复利因素，使得当前价格与目标之间的差距非常显着。

复合机如何损失三分之一的价值

ISRG 今年迄今下降了 34.02%，过去 12 个月下降了 21.17%。 触发因素是较慢的引导，而不是破碎的业务。 2026 年全年达芬奇手术增长率定为 13.5% 至 15.5%，明显低于投资者预期的约 18% 的增速。

关税加剧了损害。 仪器和配件在墨西哥制造，内窥镜在德国制造，某些材料来自中国。 管理层将关税造成的 1.0% 收入拖累纳入毛利率指引，并警告称，关税进一步升级可能会对业绩产生重大影响。 汇丰银行将该股评级从“买入”下调至“持有”，并将目标价从 604 美元下调至 391 美元。 11,113 件达芬奇 SP 窗帘的二级召回增加了噪音，而与 ACA 补贴到期相关的美国择期手术的放缓结束了这一下降。

立即行动：2010 年致电 NVIDIA 的分析师刚刚列出了他心目中的十大人工智能股票，而 Intuitive Surgical 并未上榜。 今天免费获取名字。

为什么公牛队仍然在船上

分析师仍然看好，因为基础业务在抛售期间继续超出预期。 2026 年第二季度非 GAAP 每股收益为 2.80 美元，市场预期为 2.50 美元，收入为 28.9 亿美元，同比增长 18.5%，连续第五个季度超出预期。 非 GAAP 毛利率从 67.9% 扩大至 70.0%。

牛市论点基于达芬奇 5 升级周期。 第二季度的投放量达到 246 dV5 系统，首席财务官杰米·萨马斯 (Jamie Samath) 将这一轨迹与 Xi 周期进行了比较，“我们花了大约七年的时间才达到以旧换新量的峰值”。 加上不断增长的经常性工具基础、86.3 亿美元的现金以及 2027 年推出的扩展使用工具计划。 评级组合显示，7 名分析师将 ISRG 评为“强力买入”，16 名分析师给予“买入”评级，9 名分析师给予“持有”评级，只有 1 名分析师给予“卖出”评级。
